title: GDPR Compliance Risk Calculator - Assess Your Risk Score
metaDescription: Calculate your GDPR compliance risk score. Assess data processing, security measures, and compliance gaps to avoid hefty GDPR fines.
description: Evaluate your organization's GDPR compliance risk level by assessing data processing activities, security measures, privacy policies, and breach response procedures. Get actionable insights to improve compliance.

inputs.label: Data Processing Volume
inputs.helpText: Estimate the number of EU individuals whose data you process

inputs.label: Data Sensitivity Level
inputs.helpText: Type of personal data your organization processes

inputs.label: Privacy Policy Quality
inputs.helpText: Quality and completeness of your privacy documentation

inputs.label: Consent Management
inputs.helpText: How you obtain and manage user consent

inputs.label: Data Security Measures
inputs.helpText: Technical and organizational security measures in place

inputs.label: Third-Party Data Sharing
inputs.helpText: Extent of data sharing with processors and partners

inputs.label: Breach Response Plan
inputs.helpText: Do you have a documented data breach response procedure?

inputs.label: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
inputs.helpText: Do you have a designated DPO or privacy officer?

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Risk category based on your assessment

outputFields.label: Potential Fine Range
outputFields.description: Estimated fine range based on risk factors

formula: let score = 0; const weights = { dataVolume: { low: 5, medium: 15, high: 25 }, dataSensitivity: { basic: 5, standard: 15, sensitive: 25 }, privacyPolicy: { none: 20, basic: 10, compliant: 0 }, consentMechanism: { none: 15, basic: 8, advanced: 0 }, dataProtection: { minimal: 20, moderate: 10, robust: 0 }, thirdPartySharing: { none: 0, some: 5, extensive: 15 } }; Object.keys(weights).forEach(key => { score += weights[key][inputs[key]] || 0; }); if (!inputs.breachResponse) score += 10; if (!inputs.dpoAssigned) score += 5; const riskLevel = score <= 25 ? 'Low Risk' : score <= 50 ? 'Medium Risk' : score <= 75 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; const potentialFine = score <= 25 ? '€0 - €100K' : score <= 50 ? '€100K - €1M' : score <= 75 ? '€1M - €10M' : 'Up to €20M or 4% of revenue'; return { riskScore: Math.min(score, 100), riskLevel, potentialFine };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates GDPR compliance risk based on key factors including data processing volume, sensitivity, security measures, consent management, and organizational safeguards. The scoring system reflects common compliance gaps that lead to regulatory enforcement.
tips: Implement a robust consent management system to clearly document user permissions and allow easy withdrawal
Use privacy-focused tools like Incognito Browser to minimize unnecessary data collection and protect user privacy
Create a comprehensive data breach response plan and test it regularly with your team
Conduct regular privacy impact assessments (PIAs) for new data processing activities
Maintain detailed records of processing activities and ensure all third-party agreements include GDPR clauses
